field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: List current executable models only; this aggregation invokes none.
field_principles.acceptance_gate_results: Record expected, observed, passed, and purpose for every check.
field_principles.cost_bound_rows: Retain per-seed measured fractions and counterfactual upper limits.
field_principles.cost_envelope_complete_score: One means faithful reduction and explicit assumptions, not speed success.
field_principles.duration_s: Measure total monotonic elapsed and disjoint phase spans.
field_principles.execution_venue: Record host work as host work without a device claim.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Preserve the exact upstream, check, field, observed, and expected values.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Use complete_ for findings and blocked_ for unchanged external failure.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Describe the actual upstream-artifact aggregation substrate.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Use aggregation because no generation occurs and never pad time.
field_principles.invocation_counts: Separate every load and generation outcome, including in-flight work.
field_principles.model_invoked: Set true for any attempted load or generation, including unusable work.
field_principles.next_mechanism_warrant: Name a technique only when a measured replaceable cost is sufficient.
field_principles.nfr01_assessment: Keep the original tenfold target separate from the local 1.5x gate.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Hash real inputs and record actual availability and failed checks.
field_principles.random_seed: Seal reduction and bootstrap seeds before computing outcomes.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Bind code, inputs, configuration, and reduced evidence.
field_principles.rows: Retain each paired seed and arrival process with metrics, costs, and dispositions.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260914 with actual UTC start and end plus monotonic phase timing.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Keep planned, attempted, complete, and censored counts with the fixed rule.
field_principles.schema: Version the record while keeping ordinary top-level experiment_id and milestone.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Authenticate producer identity, terminal class, and exclusion state.
field_principles.status: Write terminal evidence only after checks; keep retry state in checkpoints.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Record exact commands, scope, exit codes, elapsed time, and log hashes.
field_principles.verdict_class: Use only the closed verdict classes and reserve partial for owned unfinished work.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Shared evaluator authority cannot create positive scientific value.
